QuestInfo.name: Desert Wagon Escort
QuestInfo.0: Escort Hatsar's wagon across the desert.
QuestInfo.1: You must escort Hatsar's Servant to safety.\r\n#b(Cross the desert using the portal on the right.)#k
QuestInfo.2: You escorted Hatsar's wagon safely across the desert.

0.0: Whew! Lemme tell ya, I thought I was gonna faint out there in the desert. Then I'd be in a REAL fix.\r\n#L0##bWhat happened?#l\n#k
0.1: Those dang #emonsters#n attacked the merchants! I'm the only one who got out of there safely. I was playing dead until they left... Then I ran off... With a few extra valuables...\r\n#L0##bMonsters?#l\n#k
0.2: Oh good, you don't care about the valuables... That's right. I've never seen monsters like them. Ohh, they smelled really bad. As if they were rotting. Gives me goosebumps just talking about them. But are you alone? Where's your party?\r\n#L0##bI travel alone. Let's go before the sun sets.#l\n#k
0.3: What? You're going to keep me safe? Alone? ...Are you serious?

yes.0: W-wait! Okay, okay. I'll go with you!\r\n#b(Cross the desert using the portal on the right. You must escort Hatsar's Servant to safety.)#k

no.0: I thought you were hired by Hatsar to help me?

1.0: Wow, I didn't know you were so strong! You certainly don't look the type.

yes.0: Hm, you're not the friendliest person around... But I like you anyway! Here, I can give you some useful information.
